metadata.title: SSPP Instance - Secure Identity Provider (Microsoft Entra ID)
metadata.remarks: Slim SSPP instance assessing Microsoft Entra ID as an identity provider against institutional Secure Identity assurance requirements.

import-profile.remarks: Inherits all normative identity assurance requirements from the Secure Identity Provider SSPP template.

system-characteristics.system-description: Cloud-based identity provider delivering authentication, federation, and identity assurance services for institutional users and systems.

props.name: identity-provider-type
props.remarks: Identity provider is delivered as a multi-tenant cloud service.

props.name: authentication-model
props.remarks: Most user identities authenticate via federation with on-premises ADFS and Shibboleth identity providers.

props.name: native-identities
props.remarks: Native cloud identities are limited to Global Administrator and break-glass emergency accounts.

props.name: mfa-enforcement
props.remarks: Multi-factor authentication is enforced using Conditional Access policies.

props.name: persistent-session-behavior
props.remarks: Persistent session mechanisms (e.g., Keep Me Signed In) are currently enabled.

props.name: password-policy-enforcement
props.remarks: Password policy enforcement is centralized through Entra ID and upstream identity sources.

props.name: breached-password-protection
props.remarks: Breached and weak password detection is available through Entra ID password protection features.

props.name: identity-risk-monitoring
props.remarks: Native identity risk signals and detections are available through Entra ID identity protection capabilities.

props.name: federation-dependencies
props.remarks: Authentication assurance depends on upstream on-premises federation services.

props.name: identity-logging
props.remarks: Authentication events, risk signals, and administrative actions are logged and available for audit and investigation.

components.title: Secure Identity Provider - Microsoft Entra ID
components.description: Assessment of Microsoft Entra ID against institutional Secure Identity assurance patterns.

links.text: Asserts compliance with the Secure Identity composite pattern subject to documented findings.

components.remarks: Identity lifecycle provisioning, DRP behavior, and authorization semantics are evaluated in separate SSPPs.

control-implementation.remarks: Identity assurance for Microsoft Entra ID is evaluated based on authentication strength, credential protection, session controls, identity risk monitoring, federation trust, privileged identity safeguards, and evidence availability. Deviations from required assurance levels are tracked in SARs.
